data_objects.name: annual_education_expenditure_observations
data_objects.meaning: Coded annual education-expenditure observations by reporting location, education subject category, and calendar year.
data_objects.notes: The table uses compact statistical codes and includes both location-level observations and an aggregate-location code.

variables.name: LOCATION
variables.meaning: Code for the reporting country, economy, or aggregate geography.

variables.name: SUBJECT
variables.meaning: Code for the education-level or subject grouping to which the observation applies.

variables.name: MEASURE
variables.meaning: Code for the measurement basis; PC_GDP denotes a percentage-of-GDP basis.

variables.name: FREQUENCY
variables.meaning: Observation-frequency code; A denotes annual observations.

variables.name: Value
variables.meaning: Education-expenditure value on the basis specified by MEASURE.

variables.name: Flag Codes
variables.meaning: Optional status flag associated with Value; M is used alongside blank values.

structure.description: Each row is one observation for a LOCATION, INDICATOR, SUBJECT, MEASURE, FREQUENCY, and TIME tuple; that dimensional tuple is the natural candidate key.
Rows are grouped by LOCATION and SUBJECT, with TIME progressing within those groups; aggregate-location rows are retained in the same object as geographic rows.
A blank Value represents an unavailable observation in the visible encoding and is paired with M in Flag Codes.

uncertainties: No codebook is supplied for LOCATION, INDICATOR, SUBJECT, MEASURE, FREQUENCY, or Flag Codes, so precise code expansions beyond text-supported interpretations remain uncertain.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in train.csv and its declared packet.
